name: Modal
description: A dialog that takes over the page until closed, centered or attached to a viewport edge.

open.description: Whether the dialog is open; updates from the parent never call onOpenChange.

defaultOpen.description: Whether the dialog is open on mount when `open` is not set; read once.

trigger.description: Element that opens the dialog, keeping its own props and ref; text renders as a Button.

title.description: Heading of the dialog, which also gives the dialog its accessible name.

description.description: Text under the title, announced as the dialog's description.

children.description: Body of the dialog, mounted while it is open; text renders as body copy.

footer.description: Region under the body, aligned to the end, usually the dialog's buttons; they close nothing on their own.

closable.description: Shows the close button and lets Escape and backdrop presses close the dialog; false leaves closing to its own controls.

closeOnBackdropClick.description: A press on the backdrop closes the dialog; ignored while `closable` is false.

labels.description: Names of the dialog's own controls.

placement.description: Where the surface sits: centered, or against the start, end, top or bottom edge; start and end follow the direction.

edge.description: Edge placements only: `inset` keeps a gap with rounded, bordered corners; `flush` touches the edge, square and borderless.

width.description: Surface width in pixels, capped by the viewport.

height.description: Surface height in pixels, capped by the viewport.

scrollLock.description: Stops the page behind the open dialog from scrolling; off by default, and ignored when `portal` is false.

portal.description: Renders into document.body as a modal layer; false renders a static preview inside the parent that leaves the page, keys and focus alone.

props.title: Modal
props.children: Review the workspace details before creating it.

props.title: Customer details
props.children: Plan: Enterprise. Last active 12 minutes ago.

notes: placement selects centered or edge-aligned dialog geometry, start and end following the direction; edge selects inset or flush attachment for edge placements.
width and height write private runtime custom properties while default sizing remains in the modal token namespace.
